texts.Additional Information: Solutions engineering for an evals platform is close to my daily work: I run a production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines) in public - MCP connectors, RAG over a 10-year knowledge base, 100+ automated routines - and I publish reliability evals for it (0/17 high-risk actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs). The customer-facing half: 15+ years founder/BD, 10,000+ founder calls, enterprise advisory for subsidiaries of Foxconn and ANA Airlines. Note on LinkedIn: I don't keep an account - my work lives at https://tonydzi.github.io/ and https://github.com/tonydzi. On an active US O-1, no sponsorship needed, available immediately, regularly in Palo Alto.
